parameters.subject: 📊 Weekly Analytics Report - {{ new Date().toLocaleDateString() }}

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_tickets,
  AVG(confidence_score) as avg_confidence,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'auto_resolved' THEN 1 END) as auto_resolved,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'escalated' THEN 1 END) as escalated,
  AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'auto_resolved' THEN confidence_score END) as auto_resolve_confidence
FROM support_tickets 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
